owl_hello.speaker: Owl Keeper
owl_hello.text: The path is listening. Bring me three herbs, or take this feather and go.

owl_herbs.speaker: Owl Keeper
owl_herbs.text: Three leaves. Bring them back when the bundle is ready.

owl_feather.speaker: Owl Keeper
owl_feather.text: The feather will open the next clearing.

traveler_hello.speaker: Wounded Traveler
traveler_hello.text: The wizard crossed me. A bandage would help, if you can spare one.

traveler_thanks.speaker: Wounded Traveler
traveler_thanks.text: You spoke with the keeper. That is enough for me.

traveler_bye.speaker: Wounded Traveler
traveler_bye.text: Then watch the sky. He flies low.

hermit_hello.speaker: Swamp Hermit
hermit_hello.text: The crocodile owns the crossing until someone stills it.

hermit_mark.speaker: Swamp Hermit
hermit_mark.text: Jump the lunge. Do not try to block the teeth.

scout_hello.speaker: Palace Scout
scout_hello.text: The ninja throws high, level, and low. Match the shield, then strike.

choices.text: Mark the palace on my map.

scout_map.speaker: Palace Scout
scout_map.text: The gate is the far end of this hall.
